objective: Extend the retained actual pexprb54s4 level-1 prefix through dependency level 2 (U3/D3 and U4/D4) as a read-only safety-research probe, without computing either endpoint or activating switching.

dependency_structure: level2: U3/D3 and U4/D4, independent once D2 is known
level3: main and embedded endpoints; forbidden in the v2.8 campaign

resumability.rule: level1 -> level2 -> full-step resume must reproduce ordinary pexprb54s4 final state, embedded state, error estimate, fused-phi reports, level1 telemetry, and total WorkCounters exactly; no level1 or level2 work may be repeated.

runtime_causality.policy: k3-development only for the main campaign; frozen k1 remains a negative comparator artifact and is not retuned
runtime_causality.probe_target: first subsequently proposed R-JF trial after the causal k3 event

kill_questions: Do rho3/rho4 or their predeclared descriptive combinations separate the repeated HIRES inadmissible event from admissible HIRES neighbors better than rho2?
What incremental vector/RHS/phi work is paid from level1 to level2?
Does any family acquire a level2 prefix failure or new group-local pathology?
Does level1->level2->resume retain exact one-shot numerical/work parity?
hard_gates: R-JF committed trajectory and R attempt trace remain unchanged
full E continuation count is zero in campaign
all level2 speculative work is retained
no final safety threshold is selected from v2.8 outputs
stop_conditions: level2 factoring changes ordinary pexprb54s4 output or work counters
endpoint work appears in the v2.8 research campaign
a final safety threshold is tuned from the same campaign
